meta.title: Sample Singapore journeys: from 48 hours to a week | Five Foot Way
meta.description: Four sample itineraries for Singapore beyond the skyline: a 48-hour stopover, a shophouse week, a nature-first trip and a family trip, all planned around heat and rain.

hero.title: Sample journeys
hero.sub: Four ways to shape a trip. Borrow one, or tell us what you like and we will build yours.

intro.text: Each journey below follows the same rules: walk early, rest at midday, expect the storm, eat late. One neighbourhood a day is plenty. Every trip is adapted to your dates, the season, your flights and your pace, and quoted on enquiry.

items.title: The 48-hour stopover
summary: Two days that show the city beyond the airport and the bay: the shophouse districts, two hawker centres a day, an early walk in the Botanic Gardens and a final evening in Katong, twenty minutes from your flight.

plan.title: Chinatown and the Civic District
text: Land, check in, and walk Telok Ayer to Tanjong Pagar in the late afternoon. Dinner at Maxwell. Next morning, if you are staying a second night, the river walk.

plan.title: Midday in the museums
text: National Gallery or the Asian Civilisations Museum through the hottest hours, lunch at Lau Pa Sat.

plan.title: Botanic Gardens at dawn, Katong by afternoon
text: The gardens from Tanglin Gate at 6:30am, breakfast at Adam Road, a rest, then Joo Chiat and laksa before a short taxi to Changi.

items.title: The shophouse week
summary: A week spent in the old neighbourhoods, staying in a shophouse hotel, with one district a day and long hawker lunches in between. Ideal in the Northeast Monsoon's dry phase, from February.

plan.title: Arrive, Keong Saik at dusk
text: Settle into a shophouse hotel in Chinatown and walk the lanes once the heat breaks.

plan.title: Chinatown and Tanjong Pagar
text: Temples and five-foot ways in the morning, Chinatown Complex for lunch, the Peranakan Museum in the afternoon.

plan.title: Tiong Bahru and the river
text: Breakfast at the market, the pre-war flats, an afternoon on the river and the Asian Civilisations Museum.

plan.title: Kampong Glam and Little India
text: The mosque and Arab Street in the morning, Tekka for lunch, temples at dusk.

plan.title: Katong and Joo Chiat
text: The Peranakan terraces, kueh shops, East Coast Park in the late afternoon and satay by the sea.

plan.title: Depart
text: A last kopi, and Changi Village for nasi lemak on the way to the airport.

items.title: Rainforest and island
summary: Early starts and green places: Bukit Timah at dawn, the Southern Ridges, the mangroves of Sungei Buloh, a day by bicycle on Pulau Ubin and an evening at the Night Safari.

plan.title: Botanic Gardens
text: Arrive, and walk the gardens in the late afternoon light.

plan.title: Bukit Timah and MacRitchie
text: The summit at dawn, a rest at midday, the MacRitchie boardwalks the next morning if you still have the legs.

plan.title: The Southern Ridges
text: Kent Ridge to Mount Faber before ten, lunch at HarbourFront, a quiet afternoon.

plan.title: Pulau Ubin
text: The first bumboat, bikes to Chek Jawa, back before the storms. Night Safari in the evening.

plan.title: Sungei Buloh, then depart
text: Mangroves and shorebirds at low tide (in the migratory season), then a late flight.

items.title: A family week
summary: Mornings outdoors, afternoons in the pool or a cool museum, early dinners at hawker centres where children can choose for themselves. Bird Paradise, the zoo, a bicycle day on Pulau Ubin and plenty of rest.

plan.title: Arrive and swim
text: A hotel with a pool, and an early dinner at a nearby hawker centre.

plan.title: Gardens by the Bay
text: The Cloud Forest at midday, the children's garden and the waterfront in the evening.

plan.title: Mandai
text: The zoo at opening, a rest, then Bird Paradise or the Night Safari.

plan.title: Botanic Gardens
text: The Jacob Ballas Children's Garden in the morning, a slow afternoon.

plan.title: Pulau Ubin
text: Bumboat, bikes with child seats, Chek Jawa, nasi lemak at Changi Village.

plan.title: Chinatown and the river
text: A short walk, a long lunch, the river by boat in the evening.

plan.title: Depart
text: Jewel's Rain Vortex before the flight.
